The Interval of a New Group's Parameter

Source: R/predict_objects.R
group_interval.Rd

Selects the interval of the parameter of a new group, that is, the parameter at a level of a modelterms7::random() term that is not in the fitting data. It adds the variation of the effects of a new group to the uncertainty of the estimates. It requires random = "zero" or "marginal" in predict.StatmodFit() and implies se = TRUE.

Usage

group_interval()

Value

An S7 object of class GroupInterval, inheriting from interval_type(), with the one property label.

Details

The ends are quantiles of the new group's predictor carried through the inverse link; the standard error is the standard deviation of the new group's parameter. See predict_intervals for the formulas and the restrictions.

See also

confidence_interval(), prediction_interval(), predict_intervals, predict.StatmodFit().

Examples

set.seed(1)
dd <- data.frame(g = factor(rep(1:8, each = 5)), x = runif(40))
dd$y <- 1 + dd$x + rnorm(8, sd = 0.5)[dd$g] + rnorm(40, sd = 0.3)
fit <- statmod(y ~ x + random(~ 1 | g), distributions7::gaussian1_distrib(),
               dd)
predict(fit, what = "mu", newdata = data.frame(x = 0.5, g = "new"),
        random = "zero", interval = group_interval())
#>        fit        se     lower   upper
#> 1 1.470069 0.5548627 0.3825577 2.55758
